notes.title: Patch 1.2 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello Neon Boosters!

Patch 1.2 is live for all players.
Below are the patch notes:

Performance & Controls

 FPS drops fixed: General optimization across all levels. Also, there was a FPS drop when the player performs a Wallrun, which has been fixed.

 Final time of 0 seconds on all levels: Due to the way the timer started on each level, it was possible to avoid its activation. Now the timer starts a bit earlier before touching the ground for the first time.

 Fall force during a Wallrun increased: While Wallrunning, fall force will be more natural if you stop moving forward.

 Camera movement deactivated when dying or finishing a level: Previously it was possible to move the camera when dying or reaching the goal. This has been fixed.

 Rocket Launcher shoot delay fixed: In some levels the delay between Rockets was lower than expected. Now the delay it's the same on all levels.

 Inverted Y axis: Added an option in the Settings menu to invert the Mouse Y axis. 

 Default sensitivity: The default sensitivity when launching the game for the first time has been adjusted. This won't affect previous configurations.

 AZERTY improvements: We've tested the AZERTY configuration and made improvements to the inputs. In order to configure the AZERTY layout: 
     - On the Launcher, select the "Input" tab
     - Double click on the "w","s","a","d" buttons ("Secondary" column)
       and press the desired key for each control according to your layout. 



Visual

 UI enhanced: We've adjusted colors and other UI elements to match each of the three worlds colors. Also, the navigation bar for the levels has been modified. 

 Retro filter added: Introduced a new Retro filter effect for all the levels and menu.


Audio

 Fixed Music volume on Cosmic Highway (World 3): The Music slider on the Settings menu wasn't affecting the music volume on Cosmic Highway. This has been fixed.



Thanks for playing and wish you enjoy this new update!

- Sample Text Studio

notes.title: Update 1.2 Announcement & 100K downloads celebration!
notes.notes:
Hi neon boosters!

We are so happy to announce that Neon Boost has reached 100K downloads!
To celebrate this we want to share with all of you our plans for the Update 1.2, that will be available next month. Some of the changes/fixes are:

- Inverted mouse control
- UI rework
- AZERTY keyboard support
- Default sensitivity change
- Cosmic Highway music volume fix
- 0 seconds timer fix (finally!)
- General optimization
- Additional bugfixing

In addition, we want to thank you for the support that our game has received since the launch day on 20th May. For a team of four Game Design students is an honor to see a great community enjoying this game and sharing their feedback and gameplay.

Will be more levels? Leaderboards? Aggresive monetization systems? That's something we will discuss in the future (but don't worry, not the last one).

Enjoy the summer and see you in August!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Patch 1.1 is live for all players. Thanks for the patience. 
Below are the patch notes from the previous announcement:

Patch Notes


 Added resolution and graphic quality options
 Added a missing text when the player doesn't get the minimum time on a level (required to unlock the next level)
 Reduced default value of Mouse sensitivity 
 Reduced default value of "Effects" sounds
 Fixed some out of bounds collisions on Laser City and Tesla Factory
 Bugfixing



For AZERTY users

With the Launcher options you should be able to remap WASD to your own preferences. If you find any problem please contact us.

Advanced Graphical Options

With the Launcher options you should be able to run Neon Boost on lower settings, but our plan is to add more settings in the upcoming weeks (via in-game Settings options)
